title: Phân hệ 7: Tuyến đường Di chuyển & Quảng cáo theo Route (Physical ERD)
code:
erDiagram
    ROBOT_ROUTE {
        int RobotRouteID PK
        int RobotID FK
        int MapID FK
        varchar RouteName
        varchar RouteType
        int ZoneID FK
        varchar Description
        datetime CreatedAt
    }
    ROUTE_NODE_MAPPING {
        int RouteNodeMappingID PK
        int RobotRouteID FK
        int NodeID FK
        int SequenceOrder
        int DwellTimeSeconds
    }
    ROUTE_ASSIGNMENT {
        int RouteAssignmentID PK
        int RobotID FK
        int RobotRouteID FK
        datetime AssignedAt
        varchar Status
    }
    AD_CAMPAIGN_ROUTE {
        int AdCampaignID PK,FK
        int RobotRouteID PK,FK
        decimal RoutePriceCharged
        datetime PurchasedAt
    }
    AD_ROUTE {
        int AdRouteID PK
        varchar RouteName
        varchar Description
        bit IsActive
        bit IsAutonomous
        datetime CreatedAt
    }
    AD_ROUTE_CAMPAIGN {
        int AdRouteID PK,FK
        int AdCampaignID PK,FK
    }
    AdRouteNodes {
        int AdRouteNodeID PK
        int AdRouteID FK
        int NodeID FK
        int SequenceOrder
        int DwellTimeSeconds
        int ZoneID FK
        int ShelfID FK
    }
    ROBOT_AD_ROUTE_ASSIGNMENT {
        int AssignmentID PK
        int RobotID FK
        int AdRouteID FK
        datetime AssignedAt
        varchar Status
    }
